tools.name: list_sites

tools.name: get_site
tools.description: Return one site's details: live URL, status, plan, served file paths, whether editable source is stored (and its build settings), custom domains, bandwidth and the last 10 deploys. tools.name: delete_site
tools.description: Soft-delete a site (confirm:true required). tools.name: get_site_analytics

tools.name: read_file

tools.name: read_files

tools.name: list_file_hashes
tools.description: Return SHA-256 and size of every served file. Before a redeploy, hash your local files, compare, and upload only the changed ones with update_site mode:'patch' or begin_deploy plus add_files.

tools.name: list_source_files
tools.description: List path, SHA-256 and size of every file in the site's editable source tree (the stored pre-build code, not the served files). Read-only. A site without a source tree returns SOURCE_NOT_STORED: write the source with write_source_files, or copy plain static served files with promote_dist_to_source.

tools.name: promote_dist_to_source

The served files do not change, and a site that already has source is left as is. Use mode 'force' only after tellin

tools.name: read_source_file
tools.description: Return one file from the site's editable source tree (the stored pre-build code), so any chat can edit the site without the original local files. list_source_files shows the paths. Use read_source_file for source; use read_file instead for the files the site serves.

tools.name: read_source_files
tools.description: Read up to 50 files from the editable source tree in one call (8388608 bytes in total). Each path succeeds or fails on its own; paths past the budget fail with BATCH_BUDGET_EXCEEDED. Use read_source_files for source; use read_files instead for the files the site serves.

tools.name: write_source_files
tools.description: Write or overwrite files in the site's editable source tree (the first write creates it). The served files do not change until build_and_deploy runs. tools.name: delete_source_file
tools.description: Remove one file from the site's editable source tree. The served files do not change until build_and_deploy runs.

tools.name: build_and_deploy
tools.description: Build the site's stored editable source in an isolated one-shot build pod and atomically publish the output as the live site, replacing the served files (a restore point is normally taken first). Use build_and_deploy after changing stored source (write_source_files, apply_edits with target 'source')

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search every file of a site for a literal string or a regular expression: the served files by default, or the editable source tree with target 'source'. Use it before reading files in bulk, to find the ones that matter.

tools.name: deploy_from_url
